info.title: pruna/p-video-2
info.description: The request body Comfy Router accepts for the model "pruna/p-video-2", and the response body it returns. The INPUT schema is the same schema the server validates a call against before it reaches the provider, so what is published and what is enforced cannot differ. The OUTPUT schema describes the provider's native result document exactly as Router returns it: Router does not validate, narrow or re-envelope the response, so the output schema is descriptive rather than enforced, and Comfy owns no output shape of its own.

schema.description: Request body for `POST /proxy/pruna/v1/predictions/p-video-2`. The model is fixed by the route, so the body carries only Pruna's `input` object.

input.prompt: A single red maple leaf resting on a plain white background.

200.description: OK - the model's native JSON output, returned unchanged; the schema describes the provider's terminal result document as Router returns it.

schema.description:
Comfy Router output schema for `pruna/p-video-2`: the terminal `GET /proxy/pruna/v1/predictions/status/{id}` document, forwarded unchanged. The operation is SUBMIT-AND-POLL and Router polls on the caller's behalf, so the body a caller receives is the finished prediction (`status: succeeded`) rather than the handle the submit returns.
The generated video is at `generation_url`. A failed prediction carries `error` instead, and a canceled one carries only `status` and `message`.

PrunaPVideo2Input.description: P-Video-2 generation parameters. The generation is billed per second of the finished video, measured from the returned file, at a rate set by `resolution` and `draft`. The safety filter is always on; a `disable_safety_filter` value in the request is ignored.

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio: 16:9, 9:16, 4:3, 3:4, 3:2, 2:3 or 1:1. Ignored when `image` is set.

audio.description: Input audio URI to condition the generation (flac, mp3 or wav). The output length follows the audio.

draft.description: Faster, lower-quality preview, billed at the draft rate.

duration.description: Duration of the generated video in seconds (1-20). When omitted the model chooses the length from the prompt, up to 20 seconds. Ignored when `audio` is set.

image.description: Input image URI for image-to-video (jpg, jpeg, png or webp).

last_frame_image.description: Reference image URI for the last frame.

prompt_upsampling.description: Rewrite the prompt before generation. Disable it when a `seed` must reproduce a result.

seed.description: Random seed for reproducible generation. Random when omitted.

error.description: Error message. Present when status is failed.

generation_url.description: URL of the finished video. Present when status is succeeded.

status.description: Prediction status: starting, processing, succeeded, failed or canceled.
